Section B, new, from the Night rain recipe. Rain, with ribbons when the melody swells. Ribbons behind the nearest ridge, rain in front. Lightning cracks on the stabs. Changes cut in on the bar line. Colours: one hue against two. Pace: driving, pulsing on every beat.
